title: Cytokinetics to Announce Second Quarter Results on August 6, 2026
summary: SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., July 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Cytokinetics, Incorporated (Nasdaq: CYTK) today announced that it is scheduled to report second quarter results on August 6, 2026 at 4:00 PM Eastern Time. Following the announcement, Cytokinetics’ senior management will host a conference call at 4:30 PM Eastern Time to discuss financial results and provide business updates. The conference call will be simultaneously webcast and can be accessed from the Investors Media section of Cytokinetics’ website at www.cytokinetics.com or directly at the following link: Cytokinetics Q2 2026 Earnings Conference Call . An archived replay of the webcast will be available via Cytokinetics’ website for six months.
